read.passage: Last month, Lama and her family went on a trip to Jeddah. They flew from Riyadh, and the flight was less than two hours. On the first day, they swam in the Red Sea and had a picnic on the beach. Lama's little brother found a beautiful shell. On the second day, they visited the old town, Al-Balad. The houses there are older than most buildings in Jeddah, and they have wooden windows. Lama took lots of photos. It was very hot, so her mum said, 'You should drink plenty of water and wear a cap.' Lama thinks Jeddah is more beautiful than Riyadh because it has the sea. She wants to go back next year.

qs.q: How did Lama's family get to Jeddah?
qs.cando: Can understand short stories and messages about past events and plans.

read2.passage: Last Saturday was Omar's twelfth birthday. In the morning, he opened his presents. His parents gave him a new football, and his sister made him a card. In the afternoon, the family drove to a farm outside Buraidah. Omar's uncle has a lot of camels and palm trees there. Omar fed a baby camel and picked dates with his cousins. It was hotter than in the city, so they sat under the palm trees and drank cold juice. In the evening, they had a big dinner with a chocolate cake. 'It was the best birthday ever,' Omar said.

qs.q: What did Omar's sister give him?
